spec: equip weapon w (null = unarmed): cut factor(+0x19c) = w.cut mult, blunt factor(+0x1a0) = w.blunt mult, pierce factor(+0x1a8) = record 'pierce damage multiplier', bleed(+0x1a4) = w.bleed, weight(+0x228) = w.combat weight; robot/human/animal damage mult (+0x1b4/+0x1b8/+0x1bc) and armour penetration (+0x1c0) from the record; race damage map (+0x1c8): each 'race damage' ref -> value0*0.01; length(+0x200) = int 'length'. Bases: blunt factor > cut factor -> blunt base(+0x1b0) = blunt damage 1, cut base(+0x1ac) = blunt damage 1 * 0.4; else cut base = cut damage 1, blunt base = 0. category(+0x1f0) = w skill category (WeaponCategory; unarmed 5 when none) selecting the weapon skill (+0x1f8): 0 katana, 1 sabres, 2 blunt, 3 heavy weapons, 4 hackers, 5 unarmed, 6 bow, 7 turrets, 8 poles.

name: Armour::Armour
spec: from the ARMOUR record: material = int 'material type' (ArmourType), class = int 'class' (ArmourClass), slot = int 'slot' (3 head, 5 body, 6 legs, 8 shirt, 9 boots). t = quality(+0x220; 1 when the record has no 'part coverage') + int 'level bonus'*0.01. With M = armourTables: cut = lerp(t, matLo.cut, matHi.cut)*classLo.cut + lerp(t, 0, 'cut def bonus'), clamp [0,0.9]; pierce = lerp(t, matLo.pierce, matHi.pierce) * 'pierce def mult'; blunt = lerp(t, matLo.blunt, matHi.blunt)*classLo.blunt + lerp(t, 0, 'blunt def bonus'), clamp [0,0.8]; cut into stun = clamp('cut into stun', 0, 1); stealth(+0x25c) = lerp(t, matLo.stealth, matHi.stealth)*lerp(t, classLo.stealth, classHi.stealth) * 'stealth mult' (<0 -> 1). coverage(+0x2a8): each 'part coverage' ref -> body part (LOCATIONAL_DAMAGE) = value0*0.01. With coverage, by slot: shirt: cut,blunt *= 0.8, pierce *= 0.5; head: stealth >= 1. Also ranged skill mult, dodge mult, unarmed bonus, athletics/combat speed mults, combat attk/def bonus (not combat-relevant here).

name: Weapon::value
spec: value(sell): the weapon's computed value (+0x1f0) x factor (helper 0x1400033c8); selling: x 'loot price mult player weapons' (idx 0x3d) when it has a maker reference (+0x208), else x 'loot price mult GEAR' (idx 0x3a)

name: Armour::value
spec: value(sell): the armour's computed value (+0x1f0); selling: x 'loot price mult GEAR' (idx 0x3a) with no maker (+0x208 null), else x 'loot price mult player armour' (idx 0x3c); x the global at idx 0x3f when +0x1e8 is set; x factor (helper 0x1400033c8)

name: StatsInfo::init

name: addXP
spec: level += gain * ((cap - level)/cap)^2, only if 0 < gain <= 20 and 0 < factor <= 20; a NaN result restores the old level (20 if that is NaN too)

name: CharStats::encumbranceDisplay
spec: max(load, 0); * 1.5 when x > 0.8 * F? 5406b (shown as run speed penalty)

name: skillDiffMult
spec: learning factor vs an opponent: d = 1 + (other - mine) / (other >= mine ? skill diff xp 2x bonus : skill diff xp 0x penalty); NaN -> 0.1; clamp d to [0.1, 6]; times a group factor (n-1)/10+1 from a related object's counts (n>1); result clamped to [0.01, 10]

name: CharStats::strengthXpFromWalking
spec: p = 1 - load; p <= 0 -> 0; else xp rate strength from walking * min(p^2, 0.5) (* 2 when carrying someone: character +0x388 set)

name: trainEngineering
spec: engineering (+0xcc, id 5): gain = 0.02 * amount * exp gain multiplier * race XP mult[5] * 0.75; addXP cap 101

name: CharStats::trainDefence
spec: after a block roll vs attacker skill s: k = blocked ? 0.4 : 0.8; gain = load(+0x190) * k * G1 * raceXP[32] * G2 * skillDiffMult(defenceLevel, s); +0xf0 grows by addXP (cap 101) with that gain

name: train
spec: train stat id s: gain = 0.02 * amount * exp gain multiplier(stored x0.25) * mult * race XP mult[s] (race +0xa0 table by StatsEnumerated id); addXP(stat(s), gain, cap 101)

name: trainUpTo
spec: as train, but only while the stat is below `limit`, and the curve uses `limit` as its cap (e.g. training dummies)

name: trainAthletics
spec: swimming state: swimming(23) trains at 5 (10 when a flag is set); else athletics(17) += f(x) * xp rate athletics and strength trains too

name: trainToughness
spec: toughness(+0x90) += G1 * k * xp rate toughness * raceXP[21] * G2 via addXP cap 101; k = 0.25 (kind 1), 0.5 (kind 5), else 0.05

name: trainFromCombat
spec: per combat event (type, opponent, damage[4]); G1 = exp gain multiplier(stored) * 0.1. type 0: attack (or martial arts if unarmed) += G1*diff*raceXP[2]*G2; weapon skill += G1*diff(weapon)*raceXP[20]*G2 (armed); dexterity += G1*diff*f*raceXP[18] (f = armour weight share). type 1: same x0.5 attack, x0.4 weapon. type 2: defence += 0.25*G1*diff*raceXP[19]; weapon x0.1; strength x0.4. type 4: defence += 2*G1*diff*raceXP[19]; toughness += xp rate toughness*G1*diff(toughness, damage sum)*raceXP[21]. type 6: attack x0.25, weapon x0.1. Then strength += G1*0.55*2*xp rate strength*k*(unarmed: 1-stats[+0x190] else stats[+0x184])*raceXP[1]; all via addXP cap 101; G2 = global XP factor (0x142133580)

name: AI::findDoorToLock
spec: Locking up hook: of the building the character is in when the faction owns it, else of the home: the first door not locked (lock level >= 1, locked, not broken) or standing open

name: AI::findBed
spec: Going to bed hook: a target kept; the bed lain in (+0x2f8 == 1); player: weighted beds; else the home building beds (function 6) first, else the town beds through the building finder (modes 2, 3, 6); the first bed with a free slot and no reservation

name: ZoneManager::biomeColour
spec: the biome image pixel under a zone centre (zone +0xa0, +0xa8), clamped to the image; R << 16 | G << 8 | B

name: Zone::spawnPoint
spec: random point in the zone bounds, 4 tries x 10: away from towns (nearest town contains, scaled radius) and the camera; on walkable ground

name: ZoneManager::populationCap
spec: sum over the player squads with this index of mult * the homeless spawn amount of the biome of the zone they stand in

name: Biome::homelessSpawnPoint

name: BiomeManager::spawnNests

name: SpawnInfoList::candidates

name: Zone::spawnHomeless
spec: not the camera zone, not flagged; squads +0x70 < mult * biome homeless spawn amount; candidates from the biome list (and a town list near a town) weighted max(0, w - existing * ratio) * faction factor (F030216 = 1), world-state conditions (F050367); weighted pick, spawned at a zone point (F048102)

name: ZoneManager::populationTick
spec: every 2 s (+0xc0): squads in the player active zones (towns clamp 0..2) against the cap F048109; zone weights mult*amount + 1 - squads (halved with a town, (w+1)*2 when empty); weighted pick -> F048137

name: Biome::spawnSquad
spec: a zone of the biome other than the camera one with fewer than 2 squads, else a random zone of the biome; spawn point F048102

name: Biome::randomPoint
spec: a random point of a random zone of the biome in its middle 80% (0.2 * 0.5 margin), 10 tries for a height / slope range

name: Biome::Biome
spec: BIOME_GROUP: bool nests at fixed markers only, int index (biome-map colour), floats acidic ground / water / homeless spawn amount, resources arid/green/swamp; claims every zone of the 64x64 grid whose biome-map colour (F048100) is the index (unclaimed: 18003-gamedata.base); its homeless spawns become a SpawnInfoList

name: SpawnInfoList::load
spec: each reference of a category: a SQUAD_TEMPLATE with weight = first value (kept when > 0), its faction (else 3943-gamedata.base); total weight +0x20

name: Town::contains
spec: (pos, mult): type 8 never; else horizontal distance to the town position < radius * mult

name: Town::radius
spec: vtable +0x2a0: non-player towns by type (+0xd8): 2 -> 2500, 3 -> 937.5, 4 -> 875, 9 -> 437.5, 8/10 -> 0, else 1250, times "town radius mult" (+0x520); player towns +0x51c (2500 when <= 1)

name: TownManager::nearest
spec: (pos, faction, except, factionList, type): nearest town across of the type (10 = any; type 8 only when asked), owned by the faction when given, skipping allies of the list

name: findTown
spec: (manager, faction, position, faction filter, exclude, own-or-public, type mask): towns other than exclude, of the filter faction if any, public (+0x380) or of faction, faction alive, the town faction relation (+0x60) above -30 or allied, type (+0xd8) in mask (or a player town), not on the faction list (+0xa8); sorted by squared distance; a random one of the nearest min(n, 4)

name: Town::setup
spec: reads the TOWN record: "town radius mult" -> +0x520 (below 0.1 -> 1, clamped 0.1..5), "type" -> +0xd8, ... Trade prices: for each item of the VENDOR_LIST 'all trade goods' ('items' refs), in town order: a factor uniform in [1 - m, 1 + m] (m = GLOBAL CONSTANTS 'trade profit margins'), then for every town already set up that prices the item, clamped to within (distance between the towns / 1e6) x m x 10 of that town's factor; stored per town (+0x4b0 map).

name: Town::setupResidents
spec: the town record "residents" per building: the resident template "building designation" goes to the building

name: VendorList::generate
spec: generate(container, n, ...): n < 0 -> the list's 'items count' (< 0: 40); n times: an entry picked at random by cumulative weight among the list's entries; a weapon entry (class 2) also picks a manufacturer from the weighted manufacturer set; blueprint (0x6b) and 0x6f classes pick from their own weighted sets; the item is created and added to the container

name: ShopTraderInventory::fillFromVendors
spec: fill(shop, faction, template, container, count): the template's vendor lists (each with a weight, its ref value 0), each turned into a VendorList for (list, faction) (F049409); count split by weight share (rounded; the remainder to the last); each list generates its share (F049397)

name: ShopTraderInventory::restock
